rules.start: A phase starts only after every prerequisite phase is durably complete and its gate passed.
rules.pass: A phase may claim only the listed first_claims and requirement groups whose complete prerequisites exist.
rules.failure: Any missing, skipped, inconclusive, or stale prerequisite keeps the phase non-passed.
rules.implementation_authorization: No phase may start before reviewer PASS, exact user plan confirmation, and separate implementation authorization.
